Title: Easy tables and easy APIs will be removed from Azure App Service on November 11, 2019

Body.Content:
Easy tables and easy APIs, along with the Mobile menu in the Azure portal will be removed on November 11, 2019, as these features have a limited audience and the existing functionality can be used in other ways.

Developers that have mobile apps with a Node.js backend can use the existing functionality from easy API and easy tables by following the guidance in this article.
